subject.title: Feature Request: Voice Recognition / Speaker Identification for Voice Interface

question: Should OpenClaw add enrolled-speaker gating to Voice Wake, push-to-talk, and Talk mode, and where should the enrollment, profile storage, and verification boundary live?
rationale: Automation cannot safely choose whether voice matching is a security boundary, which platforms/providers should participate, or how biometric-like state and provider egress should be governed.

options.title: Design the speaker-gating contract first
options.body: Create a product/security design for native capture hooks, local state, provider diarization, plugin API shape, fallback behavior, and user consent before any implementation PR.

options.title: Limit to a local macOS prototype
options.body: Allow a default-off macOS-only local prototype while explicitly deferring mobile, browser, provider diarization, and command-authorization semantics.

options.title: Defer to plugin/API work
options.body: Keep core unchanged until a plugin or ClawHub package can implement speaker verification through a documented generic audio/speaker API.

recommendation.title: Design the speaker-gating contract first
recommendation.body: Create a product/security design for native capture hooks, local state, provider diarization, plugin API shape, fallback behavior, and user consent before any implementation PR.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the broadest recent history across macOS voice, Talk runtime, Android voice capture, and Talk/Gateway config surfaces implicated by the decision.
